name: Sides of Life
source:
You've been working undercover in a human trafficking organization for a while now, completely integrated in their ranks... Until one day, your sister and her daughters suddenly show up in your life again. Will you be able to find your way between your "work" and a loving family life? Will you take down the organization, or maybe even join them in the end? Which side of life will you choose to follow?

[From Itch.io]
